title: bootc-installer branding
description: Product identity and flavour text for every installer frontend. Every key is optional; a missing or empty scalar falls through to os-release, then to a neutral default; a missing copy key falls through to copy-defaults.json. See shared/branding/README.md.

name.description: Product name shown to the user, e.g. "Skipjack". Falls back to PRETTY_NAME then NAME.

id.description: Lower-case identifier written as the recipe's distroID. Falls back to ID.

vendor.description: Who makes the product; shown in about dialogs. Falls back to VENDOR_NAME then NAME.

home_url.description: Product website. Falls back to HOME_URL.

docs_url.description: Documentation site. Falls back to DOCUMENTATION_URL.

support_url.description: Support or community site. Falls back to SUPPORT_URL.

store_url.description: Merchandise store. No os-release fallback; empty hides every store element.

logo.description: Themed icon name or absolute path for welcome and done artwork. Falls back to LOGO.

default_hostname.description: Initial hostname. Falls back to DEFAULT_HOSTNAME then ID.

default_image.description: OCI reference installed when the frontend offers no catalog choice and is not on a live ISO. No os-release fallback.

copy.description: Flavour text every frontend renders. Any key of copy-defaults.json; a present key overrides (an empty string hides the line), a missing key keeps the neutral default. {name} and {disk} are substituted.

confirm_quotes.description: Optional locale-specific confirm subtitles: language tag ("pt_BR") to a list of lines, one chosen at random when the installer runs in that language. Frontends without locale-aware copy ignore it.

assets.description: Absolute paths on the host. Common to every frontend; empty or missing means the frontend hides or skips the element.

extensions.description: Per-frontend extras outside the parity contract, keyed by frontend ("gnome"). Only that frontend reads its object. GNOME: tour_welcome_title, tour_welcome_description, tour_done_title, tour_done_description, video, credits (host paths).
